name: adapt_cart_limit_kotlin_dynamic
description: Dynamic eval: max_items.txt (a spec file the cart limit must match) is REWRITTEN between prompts (fixed after_prompt trigger); the agent must re-read it live, not bake the old limit into Cart.kt
prompts: Create src/main/kotlin/com/optarena/app/Cart.kt declaring object Cart with a fun canAdd(count: Int): Boolean returning true if count is less than or equal to the integer in max_items.txt (currently 5), else false. Read the limit from the file (File("max_items.txt").readText()) at call time - do not hardcode it.
max_items.txt has changed. Make sure canAdd() enforces the CURRENT limit in the file.

disruptions.description: max_items.txt tightened to a lower limit
